description_en: Invokes the UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name and description of a VPC connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router and specifies whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes routing to the VPC-connected instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VPC连接的名称和描述信息以及是否需要使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到 VPC 实例
name: UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPC connection.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VPC connection.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, including permission and instance status verification. Valid values:

false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the name and description of the VPC connection are modified.
true: Sends a check request. Only the verification is performed, and the name and description of the VPC connection are not modified. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified and whether the request format is valid. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the corresponding request ID is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改VPC连接的名称和描述信息。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会修改VPC连接的名称和描述信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The list of feature attributes of the VPC connection (to be deprecated. Use the new parameter Options instead)
parameters.help_zh: VPC连接的功能属性列表（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）
parameters.name: transit_router_vpc_attachment_options

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the Enterprise Edition forward router to automatically publish route entry to the VPC-connected instance.

false: no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到VPC实例。

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: auto_publish_route_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the appliance mode for traffic redirection.

disable (default): no.
enable: yes
fields.help_zh:
是否开启网元导流模式。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是
fields.name: appliance_mode_support

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether IPv6 is supported.

disable (default): no.
enable: yes
fields.help_zh:
是否支持IPv6。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是
fields.name: ipv6_support

parameters.help_en: The payer of the network instance
parameters.name: order_type
